'''Nano-scientists''' were specialized [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who dealt with the creation of [[nanovirus]]es. Nanoviruses were difficult and expensive to produce, requiring a staff of highly trained nano-scientist several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] to create.
